steps.title: Uniform programs
steps.description: Issued gear for crews of 50 to 5,000. Sizing runs, reorder windows, and a named account lead.

steps.title: Sizing programs
steps.description: On-site fit sessions for programs over 200. Sizes XS to 5XL, regular and tall, across the core line.

steps.title: Embroidery and marking
steps.description: Left chest, right chest, and back yoke. Digitized once, applied at our Kent, WA facility. 10 business days added.

steps.title: Reorder
steps.description: Core styles held in stock for 24 months from program start. Reorders ship in 10 business days.

rightSections.heading: Who buys from Ballard Field
paragraphs: Healthcare systems: facilities, transport, and grounds crews.
Utilities: line, gas, and water crews. Arc-rated programs by request.
Field service organizations with vehicle-based crews.
Corporate campuses: security, facilities, and mail.
Your account lead is a person with a phone number, not a portal. Programs under 50 units go through the dealer network.
